items: 1 lb chicken breasts, cut into ½-inch cubes
2 × 15 oz cans great northern beans, rinsed and drained

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.body: Sauté **1 lb chicken breasts**, cut into ½-inch cubes, **1 medium onion**, chopped, **1 clove garlic** and **1 tsp olive oil** until the chicken is no longer pink.

steps.title: Add the beans and seasonings
steps.body: Add **2 × 15 oz cans great northern beans**, rinsed and drained, **1¾ cups water**, **2 tsp chicken base**, **2 cans chopped green chilies**, drained, **1 tsp salt**, **1 tsp ground cumin**, **1 tsp dried oregano**, **½ tsp pepper** and **¼ tsp cayenne pepper**.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add the dairy
steps.body: Remove from heat and add **1 cup light sour cream** and **½ cup whipping cream**.
